item.summary: refactor(gateway): one owner for the submitted-config validation pipeline (#124331) config.set and config.patch each hand-rolled the same normalize -> raw-validate -> plugin-validate -> respond-invalid pipeline (including the duplicated errorShape/details blocks the round-5 error-text fix touched in both places). validateSubmittedConfigOrRespond now owns it; both handlers consume { validationCandidate, config }. Behavior-neutral: same validators in the same order, same error shapes (pinned by the existing 26 config tests including the round-5 regressions). Net -11 production LOC and one place to evolve validation error content.
